1. (CURRENTLY AMENDED) An apparatus comprising:
an interface configured to receive pixel data
corresponding to an exterior view from a vehicle; anda processor configured to (i) process said pixel data
arranged as video frames, (ii) perform computer vision operations on said video frames to detect (a) a moving object in said videoframes and (b) one or more stationary objects adjacent to said a vehicle, (iii) determine track a predicted path of said a moving object in said video frames, (iv) determine a probability of said moving object colliding with said vehicle based on said predicted path, (v) perform said computer vision operations on said video frames to measure distances to said stationary objects and second distances of lines of a parking space occupied by said vehicle to define a bounds of said parking space and (vi) generate a control signal when said probability is greater than a pre-determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to (a) enable an autonomous movement of said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object while staying within said bounds of said parking space and (b) if said predicted path of said moving object is determined to collide with said vehicle while within said bounds of said parking space, enable said autonomous movement to move said
vehicle outside of said bounds of said parking space and within
said distances between said vehicle and said stationary objects,(ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking
said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames,and(iii) (ii) said autonomous movement comprises a low
speed avoidance maneuver.
2. (PREVIOUSLY PRESENTED) The apparatus according to
claim 1, wherein said vehicle is parked in a parking lot.
3. (CANCELED)
4. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein said processor is further configured to determine an
approach angle of said moving object based on said predicted path and said autonomous movement comprises moving said vehicle in a direction based on said approach angle in order to provide more room for said moving object.
5. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein (A) said control signal is further configured to provide a
response and (B) said processor is further configured to (i) continue performing said computer vision operations on said video frames after said control signal is generated to determine a result
of said response, (ii) said result comprises whether said moving
object (a) collided with said vehicle or (b) would have collided with said vehicle if said response was not performed and (iii) compare said result with said probability to determine an accuracy of said probability based on said computer vision operations.
6. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
further configured to upload said accuracy of said probability and
said video frames used to determine said probability to a remote device, wherein said video frames are used by said remote device for training said computer vision operations.
7. (PREVIOUSLY PRESENTED) The apparatus according to
claim 1, wherein (i) said computer vision operations performed by said processor are further configured to detect portions of said stationary objects that comprise a component that is capable of movement and (ii) said processor is further configured to determine a potential event based on said computer vision operations performed on said component of said stationary objects.
8. (PREVIOUSLY PRESENTED) The apparatus according to
claim 7, wherein (i) said component that is capable of movement of said stationary objects is a car door, (ii) said processor is further configured to determine a potential trajectory of said car
door and (iii) said potential event is damage to said vehicle from
said car door based on said potential trajectory.
9. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein (i) said processor is further configured to generate said
control signal in response to said potential event and (ii) said autonomous movement is implemented for adjusting a location of said vehicle based on said potential trajectory of said component that is capable of movement of said stationary objects.
10. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein (A) said vehicle is an electric vehicle comprising a
battery that supplies power for said electric vehicle and (B) said processor is further configured to (i) read an available charge of said battery of said vehicle and (ii) disable performing said computer vision operations on said video frames when said available charge is below a pre-determined charge threshold.
11. (CURRENTLY AMENDED) An apparatus comprising:
an interface configured to receive pixel data
corresponding to an exterior of a vehicle; anda processor configured to (i) process said pixel data
arranged as video frames, (ii) perform computer vision operations on said video frames to detect a moving object in said video
frames, (iii) determine a predicted path of said moving object,
(iv) determine a probability of said moving object colliding withsaid a vehicle based on said predicted path, (v) determine a course correction for said moving object to prevent said moving object from colliding with said vehicle, (vi) generate a plurality of discrete steps to perform said course correction, and (vii) generate a control signal when said probability is greater than a pre-determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to enable an audio output played from said vehicle comprising a verbal instruction,
(ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking
said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames,(iii) said verbal instruction comprises said
plurality of discrete steps of said course correction, and(iv) said plurality of discrete steps comprise
instructions for a driver of said moving object, and(v) said processor is further configured to (a)
provide a first of said plurality of discrete steps, (b) determinewhether said moving object performed said first of said pluralityof discrete steps using said computer vision operations, (c)provide a second of said plurality of discrete steps in response todetermining that said first of said plurality of discrete steps hasbeen performed, and (d) re-analyze said course correction for said
moving object in response to determining that said first of said
plurality of discrete steps has not been performed.
12. (CANCELED).
13. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein said vehicle is parked in a parking space and does not have
an occupant.
14. (PREVIOUSLY PRESENTED) The apparatus according to
claim 11, wherein (A) said control signal is further configured to provide a response and (B) said response comprises (i) said processor generating a video stream from said video frames, (ii) said apparatus communicating said video stream to a display implemented by said moving object and (iii) said video stream comprises said plurality of discrete steps of said course correction.
15. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein said vehicle is stationary when said vehicle is idling at
a stop light and an occupant is operating said vehicle.
16. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein said apparatus is configured to perform automatic collision
detection, warning, avoidance and prevention in parked cars.
17. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein (i) said processor is further configured to (a) record a
subset of said video frames and (b) add annotations to said subset of said video frames, (ii) said subset of said video frames comprise said video frames that were used to determine said probability, (iii) said annotations comprise information about said moving object and (iv) said apparatus is further configured to communicate said subset of said video frames to an owner of said vehicle.
18. (ORIGINAL) The apparatus according to The apparatus according to
wherein (i) said processor is further configured to determine
autonomous movement of said vehicle to avoid said moving object in response to said predicted path, (ii) said control signal is further configured to enable said autonomous movement of said vehicle and (iii) said autonomous movement comprises a low speed avoidance maneuver within available space around said vehicle measured using said computer vision operations.
19. (CURRENTLY AMENDED) A method for avoiding a
collision in a parked car, comprising the steps of:generating pixel data corresponding to an exterior view
from a vehicle using a capture device;processing said pixel data arranged as video frames using
a video processor;performing computer vision operations on said video
frames to detect a moving object in said video frames;determining a predicted path of said moving object;
determining a probability of said moving object colliding
with said vehicle based on said predicted path;determining whether said vehicle is stationary;
performing said computer vision operations on said video
frames to measure distances to lines of a parking space occupied by said vehicle; andgenerating a control signal when (a) said vehicle is
stationary and (b) said probability is greater than a pre- determined threshold, wherein (i) said control signal is configured to enable an autonomous movement of said vehicle in order to move said vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object,(ii) said predicted path is determined by tracking
said moving object over time in a sequence of video frames,
(iii) said autonomous movement comprises a low speed
avoidance maneuver within said distances measured,(iv) said distances measured define a bounds of said
parking space, and(v) said autonomous movement comprises moving said
vehicle to avoid said predicted path of said moving object while staying within said bounds of said parking space.
20. (PREVIOUSLY PRESENTED) The apparatus according to
claim 11, wherein said plurality of discrete steps comprise an instruction to stop said moving object, an instruction to change a direction of travel of said moving object and an instruction to rotate a steering wheel of said moving object.
21. (CANCELED).
22. (CURRENTLY AMENDED) The apparatus according to claim
21 claim 11, wherein said processor is further configured to (i) repeat said first of said plurality of discrete steps in response to said re-analysis of said course correction for said moving object if said moving object has not performed said first of said plurality of discrete steps and (ii) determine (a) that said first of said plurality of discrete steps has been performed in response to another action by said moving object and (b) determine a next
one of said plurality of discrete steps in response to said re-
analysis of said course correction for said moving object.
